name: ash
description: ash — the personal-agent layer on top of DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

scripts.typecheck: npm run -s gen:ui && npm run -s gen:worker-rules && tsc --noEmit -p .
scripts.test: npm run -s gen:ui && npm run -s gen:worker-rules && node --expose-internals --import tsx --test packages/*/test/*.test.ts packages/core/test/arch/*.test.ts packages/core/test/contract/*.test.ts packages/core/test/fixtures/*.test.ts packages/core/test/members/*.test.ts packages/core/test/world/*.test.ts packages/core/ui/test/*.test.js
scripts.build:core: npm run -s gen:ui && npm run -s gen:worker-rules && esbuild packages/core/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=packages/core/dist/ash-core.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'node:module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:payload: npm run -s build:core && node payload/assemble.mjs --out build/payload
